name: Dorm room 114 key
description: Opens room 114 in the Customs Yard dorms, the one door nobody kicked in.

name: Factory office key
description: Opens the overseer's office above the Factory floor.

name: Marked room key
description: A key with a red mark. Opens the marked room in the Customs Yard dorms, rumoured to be full of valuables.

name: Lab Zero access keycard
description: Gets you down the elevator into Lab Zero. The reader keeps it: one card, one raid.

name: Factory exit key
description: Opens the cellar hatch in the Factory boiler house: carry it to extract through the Cellars.

name: Factory lab key
description: Opens the lab behind the Factory med bay.

name: Hunter's lodge key
description: Opens the locked lodge on the Woodland ridge, rifles still on the rack.

name: Forester's cellar key
description: An old iron key to the root cellar behind the forester's house in Woodland.

name: Resort west wing key
description: A staff key to the locked west wing of the Shoreline health resort.

name: Resort east wing key
description: A staff key to the treatment rooms of the resort's east wing.

name: Resort admin office key
description: The director's own key to the admin office at the top of the resort.

name: Lab Zero red keycard
description: Opens the red-card research wing in Lab Zero.

name: Lab Zero violet keycard
description: Opens the security armory in Lab Zero.

name: Lab Zero black keycard
description: The manager's card: his office in Lab Zero, and the vault behind it. Wears out fast.
